duration.text: The Automation at Shenyang Aerospace University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 200 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2500 USD/per year ￥ 18000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Passport first page2.Passport empty visa page3.High school graduation certificate and the Chinese translation4.High school transcript and the Chinese translation5.English competence certificate6.Medical report7.Non-criminal record certificate8.Self-introduction video in English9.Applicant who used to study or live in China needs to provide other documents based on the actual situation

requirements.text: Under the age of 25, senior high school graduation or with equivalent qualification of 12-year education background. Passing the 4th level HSK is required if study in Chinese language. Mathematics, physics and chemistry with 60% of total marks results are necessary for engineering degree courses.
